column3: aṣṭau guṇāḥ phalaṁ yatra tvatprasādān maheśvara |
jñānamārgaṁ ca mokṣam ca śūlarogaṁ ca dāruṇam ||
sphuṭaṁ vada yathā prabho prasādān me maheśvara ||
uvāca śaṁkaro devi yat tvayā paripṛcchyate |
yan na kasyacid ākhyātaṁ tad vadāmi varānane ||
purāhaṁ viṣṇunā yukto brahmaṇā saha sundari |
devyā āyatane ye tu citāṁ dahanti mānavāḥ |
aṣṭamyāṁ snāti yaḥ kuṇḍe pūjayitvā tataḥ śivam |
itthaṁ devagaṇāḥ sarve kuṇḍe snātvā kṣaṇaṁ sthitāḥ |
yaḥ pūjayati puṇyātmā mama lokaṁ sa gacchati ||
kedāraṁ pūjayed yas tu puṇyātmā bhāgyabhājanam |
indreṇa sthāpitaṁ vajraṁ kośaś ca dhanadena tu |
mayāpi sthāpitā mantrāḥ kathitaṁ te varānane ||
kenopāyena te grāhyā devapūjā kathaṁ vibho ||
kīdṛśaṁ ca vrataṁ kāryaṁ kiṁ dānaṁ kasya pūjanam |
kā ca bhaktikriyā kāryā deva me vada bhairava ||
evaṁ pūjya mahābhaktyā praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ |
baliṁ dadyād vidhānena dikṣu sarvāsu yatnataḥ ||
atha teṣāṁ maṇīnāṁ tu kartavyaṁ suparīkṣaṇam ||
gopitaṁ yan mayā pūrvaṁ tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu |
etaiś cihnaiḥ samāyukto nīlakaṇṭha iti smṛtaḥ |
pītaś ca śvetarekhaś ca maṇiḥ svacchaś ca dṛśyate |
guṇānām ākaraḥ so hi bahurogān nihanti ca ||
vikhyātaḥ sa mahāmaṇir viṣaharo baddho narāṇāṁ kare |
bhūtaṁ nāśayatīha somasadṛśas tasmāt pṛthivyāṁ priyaḥ ||
pītavarṇo bhaved yas tu dvirekhaḥ sitabindukaḥ |
netrarogaṁ ca śūlaṁ ca jalapānād vyapohati ||
raktāṅgaḥ śuddharekhaś ca ardhāṅge kṛṣṇa eva ca |
sa maṇī raktaśūlaṁ ca netraśūlaṁ vyapohati ||
vṛścikānāṁ viṣaṁ hanti sa maṇiḥ sarvakāmadaḥ ||
ratkam ardhaṁ ca kṛṣṇārdhaṁ śvetaṁ kiṁcid bhaved yadi evaṁrūpo bhaved yas tu sarpādiviṣanāśanaḥ ||
raktāṅgo raktarekhaś ca āvartaiḥ śobhanair yutaḥ |
samastaviṣaho jñeyaḥ sa maṇir jīyate dhruvam ||
